purpose: 20 warrior concept previews on tiles, not runtime sprites

variants.name: Алый авангард
variants.prompt: Make a compact pixel-art warrior ON a single tile. Image 1 is a strict LAYOUT AND SIZE TEMPLATE. Preserve that tile footprint, relative figure size and foot contact position EXACTLY. The complete warrior including his hair is 45% of the diamond width, NOT 65%. The tile must look big around the small warrior. Remove all HUD bars. Image 2 is the desired character ART STYLE only; its warrior is too big relative to tile, so do not use its composition. Redraw this warrior in the image-1 layout, with head+hair about 35% of his height, short torso and very short legs, broad shoulders. Eye-level 2D FRONT three-quarter CHARACTER, not top-down or isometric character. The TILE stays an isometric diamond 4:3. Replace the image-1 green tile material with cold gray cracked stone slabs like image2, keep its geometry and size. Low sides under tile. Dark navy background. No text. Clean pixel clusters, no blur/grain. Large readable head, compact sturdy miniature body. Full tile and figure, neither cropped. Design: brown-haired bearded armored warrior, crimson scarf, ivory tabard, bright steel pauldrons, brown boots, straight sword diagonally downward to side. IMPORTANT: do not let the character grow relative to the template; tile left-right width is more than double the warrior head-to-boot height.

variants.name: Щит дозора
variants.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE pixel-art warrior standing on ONE gray stone tile. Character including head and boots should be 43-45% of the tile's left-to-right width, not larger. Do not zoom in. Image2 is the art style, particularly the LOWER-LEFT small warrior. Create a NEW warrior design below but keep the compact squat proportions. Head including hair/helmet is about 35% of total height, broad shoulders, short torso, very short legs, big boots. About 2.8 heads tall. No elongated adult anatomy. Strong readable silhouette, a few clean connected pixel clusters per material, no grain or rivet detail, no blur. One confident asymmetric battle-ready pose. Large simple black eyes. Entire warrior and entire tile visible. No labels, text, UI, borders or other characters. Preserve template relative size consistently. NEW WARRIOR DESIGN: Clean-shaven warrior with cropped dark hair and visible face, broad steel chest armor, red half-cape, cream waistcloth. Plain compact heater shield forward on the left of the silhouette, straight sword ready on the other side. Alert compact stance, the shield must not hide the whole torso. Keep this design exceptionally compact and stout, not elongated; simplify the equipment to preserve those proportions.
